key_concepts: Evaporation separates homogeneous mixtures with one or more dissolved solids
Heating drives off liquid components and leaves solid components behind
Heat is the main factor that causes evaporation
Liquid changes to gas or vapor when heated
Table salt is obtained by evaporating sea water using heat from the sun
Salt can be harvested after sea water has evaporated
Boiling water, drying clothes, and drying wet roads are examples of evaporation
A salt solution can be separated by heating until water evaporates and salt remains
Evaporation is used in everyday life such as drying wet floors, plates, hair, and salt mak
